correctness.rationale: The rank-three Fano subspace-lattice inclusion-exclusion identity E=8+n(sum_L 1/(n-m(L))-2 sum_v 1/(n-m_v)) follows by evaluating each positive t proper-span event and the t=0 correction. Rank-deficient profiles force infinite expectation; a zero column can only delay sampling. Exhaustive integer lcm(1..n)-scaled objective independently enumerated all 71,092 full-rank seven-part profiles for n=8..13 and reproduced all six minima and COMPLETE equality sets (r=3 nonlines, r=4 complements of lines). The supplied verify.py was inspected, including exhaustive compositions and separate Markov recursion. This proves only these six finite lengths, not an unrestricted optimal code family.
